brief.topic: AI PM interview: “How would you measure the quality of an AI writing assistant?”
brief.audience: Aspiring and junior AI PMs preparing for interviews

coreInsight: A strong answer to “measure an AI writing assistant” starts by splitting it into tasks, builds an eval set per task, pairs offline rubric scores with online usage signals, and plans for failure.

caption.opening: A classic AI PM interview question: how would you measure the quality of an AI writing assistant?
body:
A structure that works:
→ Define the tasks first: emails, summaries, rewrites
→ Build an eval set from real drafts for each task
→ Offline: rubric scores for accuracy and tone
→ Online: how much text users keep, edit or retry
→ Plan for failure: made-up facts, wrong tone
What interviewers listen for: quality split by task, a usage signal beyond ratings, and failure named as a risk. “Thumbs-up rate” alone is a red flag.
